standard-dialogue.player: So what kind of spider are you...?

standard-dialogue.npc: The hive cluster is under attack!

standard-dialogue.player: Erm, I think the attack is over. I have already killed your queen.

standard-dialogue.npc: Then we should spawn more overlords!

if-the-player-uses-it-on-brother-aimeri.npc: Hey, let go of me! What are you doing?

if-the-player-uses-it-on-brother-aimeri.player: Yeah, I killed Sarachnis and she started following me, I think she's cute so I've decided to keep her around.

if-the-player-uses-it-on-brother-aimeri.speaker: Brother Aimeri
if-the-player-uses-it-on-brother-aimeri.text: Do as you wish. I've certainly seen people keep worse company than a spider.
